query:
update plis
        set etat = 'a_traiter',
            envoye_le = now(),
            date_proposee = now() + make_interval(mins => $3),
            sceau_id = (select s.id from sceaux s where s.id = plis.sceau_id and s.detenteur_id = $2),
            modifie_le = now()
        where id = $1 and auteur_id = $2 and etat = 'brouillon' and not redige_par_mj
